class.name: OcgGeomVectorwithmagnitude
class.brief_description: Defines a vector with magnitude. A vector with magnitude can have a zero length.
class.description: ! Defines a vector with magnitude. ! A vector with magnitude can have a zero length.

method.name: from_gp_Vec_const_ref
method.description: Creates a transient copy of V.

method.name: from_gp_Pnt_const_ref_gp_Pnt_const_ref
method.description: Creates a vector from the point P1 to the point P2. The magnitude of the vector is the distance between P1 and P2

method.name: from_double_double_double
method.description: Creates a vector with three cartesian coordinates.

method.name: SetCoord
method.description: Assigns the values X, Y and Z to the coordinates of this vector.

method.name: SetVec
method.description: Converts the gp_Vec vector V into this vector.

method.name: SetX
method.description: Changes the X coordinate of <me>.

method.name: SetY
method.description: Changes the Y coordinate of <me>

method.name: SetZ
method.description: Changes the Z coordinate of <me>.

method.name: Magnitude
method.description: Returns the magnitude of <me>.

method.name: SquareMagnitude
method.description: Returns the square magnitude of <me>.

method.name: Add
method.description: Adds the Vector Other to <me>.

method.name: Added
method.description: Adds the vector Other to <me>.

method.name: Cross
method.description: Computes the cross product between <me> and Other <me> ^ Other.

method.name: Crossed
method.description: Computes the cross product between <me> and Other <me> ^ Other. A new vector is returned.

method.name: CrossCross
method.description: Computes the triple vector product <me> ^ (V1 ^ V2).

method.name: CrossCrossed
method.description: Computes the triple vector product <me> ^ (V1 ^ V2). A new vector is returned.

method.name: Divide
method.description: Divides <me> by a scalar.

method.name: Divided
method.description: Divides <me> by a scalar. A new vector is returned.

method.name: Multiplied
method.description: Computes the product of the vector <me> by a scalar. A new vector is returned.

method.name: Multiply
method.description: Computes the product of the vector <me> by a scalar.

method.name: Normalize
method.description: Normalizes <me>.

method.name: Normalized
method.description: Returns a copy of <me> Normalized.

method.name: Subtract
method.description: Subtracts the Vector Other to <me>.

method.name: Subtracted
method.description: Subtracts the vector Other to <me>. A new vector is returned.

method.name: Transform
method.description: Applies the transformation T to this vector.

method.name: Copy
method.description: Creates a new object which is a copy of this vector.
